content: Good morning, Anna. I woke up thinking about you again. I hope you slept well, have you had your coffee yet?
Hi Michael. Yes, just finishing my second cup. It's always nice to wake up to your messages.
You have no idea how much your messages mean to me out here. This rig can get incredibly lonely, but knowing I have you to talk to makes every day brighter.
That means a lot, Michael. I can't imagine spending weeks at sea like you do. You're so brave.
Thank you, Anna. Having you in my life gives me so much strength. Speaking of, I wanted to talk to you about something a bit personal, if that's okay?
Of course, you can talk to me about anything. What's going on?

I just found out that my leave request got approved, finally! But there's a snag. The rig management needs a processing fee paid upfront due to some new company policy. Normally, I'd cover it, but my offshore account is frozen until payroll clears next week.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Is there another way for you to handle it?

I wish there was. I hate to even ask, but would you be able to help me cover the $1,200 fee? I promise I'll pay you back as soon as I'm back on land. You know how important it is for me to come see you.
That's a lot of money, Michael. Are you sure you can't get an advance from your company?

I completely understand your concern, Anna. I wouldn't ask if I had any other option. The company is very strict about offshore transfers, they won't even let me access my funds until the next cycle. I know it's a big ask, but I wouldn't jeopardize our relationship for anything.
I just want to make sure it's safe. How do I send it?

Thank you for trusting me. The only way management accepts the fee is through Zelle. If you could send it to my assistant's email, carlos.manning.finance@gmail.com, it'll get processed right away. Just let me know once you've sent it so I can confirm with them.
I've never used Zelle before. Is it easy to set up?
It's really straightforward! You just need to log into your bank's app and look for the Zelle option. I can walk you through it if you want, that way you know it's all done correctly.
Okay, I'll look for it. Should I enter just the email you gave me?

Yes, that's right. Use carlos.manning.finance@gmail.com as the recipient. Enter $1,200, and add a note that it's for 'leave processing.' That way, it gets routed quickly. You're incredible for doing this.
Alright, I'm just filling out the details now. Are you sure this will be safe?
Absolutely, Anna. I promise, I've used this process before and it's completely secure. As soon as I'm back, I'll pay you back in full, and with interest. I just can't wait to finally hold you.
I trust you, Michael. Sending it now.
Thank you so much, Anna. You're truly incredible. Once the payment goes through, I'll notify management and send you the confirmation. I can't wait to see you soon.
